WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    -- Start from the company model's direct components
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.is_assembly,
        mb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM company_model cm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
    JOIN component c ON mb.component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'CO4-180WAL55-0540'
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2024-01-07'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2024-01-07')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse into sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_code,
        c.is_assembly,
        bt.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN component_bom cb ON bt.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    JOIN component c ON cb.child_component_id = c.component_id
    WHERE bt.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2024-01-07'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2024-01-07')
)
SELECT SUM(total_qty) AS required_units
FROM bom_tree
WHERE component_code = 'CON-699-WAL-01903'
"}
